comments.headline: Update Regulatory References in Plan Notes
comments.summary: Plan notes cite outdated regulatory standards. The recycling ordinance reference and fire code edition must be updated to reflect current City of Austin requirements.

details.text: All references to 'Commercial and Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance' in Block 11 of the cover sheet must be changed to 'Universal Recycling Ordinance' per current City of Austin standards.

runComments.comment: Plan notes reference 'Commercial and Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance' instead of 'Universal Recycling Ordinance' per current ordinance.
Plan notes reference 'Commercial and Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance' which is outdated. Update all instances to 'Universal Recycling Ordinance' per current City of Austin ordinance.

Recycling ordinance note (Block 11, Sheet 1) references the outdated 'Commercial and Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance.' Per current City of Austin standards, this must be updated to reference the 'Universal Recycling Ordinance' to reflect the current regulatory language.

details.text: The Austin Fire Department requirements table (Block 5, Sheet 1) cites the 2021 International Fire Code Edition and must be updated to 2024 International Fire Code per Ordinance 20250410-039 and local amendments.

runComments.comment: Fire Design Codes table cites '2021 International Fire Code Edition' as the applicable standard. Update to the currently adopted 2024 IFC per Ordinance 20250410-039, effective July 10, 2025.

Austin Fire Department requirements table (Block 5, Sheet 1) cites the '2021 International Fire Code Edition.' This must be updated to the 2024 International Fire Code to reflect the current adopted edition per City of Austin local amendments.

comments.headline: Plan Notes Contain Inapplicable Language and Incomplete Information
comments.summary: Plan notes contain marine/marina template language inapplicable to the residential townhomes project, bracketed instructional placeholders not replaced with project-specific information, blank fields awaiting recorded documents, and unresolved assumptions about project legal classification.
comments.crossDep: Fire Department and Stormwater/Environmental may need to verify applicability of condominium and erosion control requirements during note revision.
comments.attn: Applicant must clarify project legal structure (condominium filing vs. multi-family rental) to resolve condominium-specific language applicability.

details.text: Fire Zone Notes Item 1 on the Fire Protection Plan references signage placement 'on front of lockers and along boat slip retaining walls,' which are marine/marina features not applicable to a residential townhomes development. Remove these inapplicable features and replace with site-specific fire zone signage requirements.

runComments.comment: Fire Zone Notes, Item 1 references placement of signage 'on front of lockers and along boat slip retaining walls as necessary or required' — these features are not applicable to this townhomes project and reflect template boilerplate language. Remove inapplicable feature references and retain only applicable fire zone signage requirements.

Fire Zone Notes, Item 1 references 'lockers and boat slip retaining walls' which are not applicable to this residential townhomes development. This boilerplate language must be removed or replaced with site-specific requirements. The note currently reads: 'Restricted Zone signage to be placed on front of lockers and along boat slip retaining walls as necessary or required.'

details.text: Fire Zone Notes #1 contains the same marine/marina boilerplate language: 'Restricted Zone signage to be placed on front of lockers and along boat slip retaining walls as necessary or required.' This template language is not applicable and must be replaced with site-specific fire zone requirements.
details.citation: DSD Application Instructions; Standard Specifications Manual

runComments.comment: Inapplicable boilerplate template text remains in Fire Zone Notes #1: 'Restricted Zone signage to be placed on front of lockers and along boat slip retaining walls...' This is marine/marina template language not applicable to a residential townhomes project and must be removed.

details.text: Site Plan Release Notes reference 'residential condominium project' with Chapter 81-82 Property Code requirements (Sheet 9, Block 5, item g), but the project is described as multi-family townhomes. Clarify the project's legal structure (condominium vs. multi-family rental) to determine if condominium language applies.

runComments.comment: Site Plan Release Notes reference 'residential condominium project' and condominium-specific requirements (Chapter 81 and 82 of Property Code compliance), but the project is a multi-family townhomes development, not a condominium structure. Remove condominium-specific language and replace with appropriate multi-family project requirements, or clarify the project's legal structure.

Condominium-specific requirement note (Chapter 81/82 Property Code compliance) is present on Sheet 9, Block 5, item (g). Applicability cannot be verified without confirmation of the project's actual legal structure (whether it will be filed as a condominium or as multi-family rental). The applicant's intent and housing/condominium documentation must be reviewed to determine if this note is appropriately applicable.

comments.headline: Plan Notes Have Quality and Organization Deficiencies
comments.summary: Site Plan Release Notes contain missing sequential numbers, duplicate and contradictory entries, multiple spelling and grammatical errors, garbled text passages, and a title block date inconsistency. These deficiencies compromise document clarity.
comments.attn: These issues were each identified by only one review run; verify all details during final document review.

details.text: Site Plan Release Notes (General Notes sheet, Block 12, Sheet 3) are numbered 1-6, 8-10 with note 7 missing. Verify whether this gap is intentional or a numbering error requiring correction and renumbering.

runComments.comment: Site Plan Release Notes on General Notes sheet show notes numbered 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 with note number 7 missing. Either note 7 was intentionally removed during consolidation or a note is incorrectly numbered. Verify note sequence and correct numbering to ensure proper organization and prevent confusion.

details.text: Both the General Notes sheet and Site Plan sheet contain the same missing note 7 deficiency (numbering skips from 6 to 8), plus orphaned or incomplete structural items within the numbered lists.

runComments.comment: Site Plan Release Notes missing item 7 (numbering skips from 6 to 8), and orphaned/incomplete structural items in numbered lists.

details.text: Multiple spelling and grammar errors across sheets 1, 3, 9, 10: 'a trees Critical Root Zone' (should be 'tree's'), extra period in 'Subchapter E 2.5.', period instead of comma after 'driveway construction', 'This project includes 1 private hydrants' (subject-verb disagreement), and 'Not empty reasons' (garbled).

runComments.comment: Multiple spelling and grammatical errors: 'a trees Critical Root Zone' (should be 'tree's'), extra period in 'Subchapter E 2.5.', period instead of comma after 'driveway construction', 'This project includes 1 private hydrants' (subject-verb disagreement), and garbled text 'Not empty reasons'.

details.text: Sheets 3 and 10 contain duplicate and contradictory note entries: Electric Transmission Notes appear as both numbered and unnumbered items; Item 15 duplicates Item 2; Fire Zone Notes #4 duplicates general Notes #2; fire suppression system references are inconsistent ('NFPAR 13' vs 'NFPA 13D').

runComments.comment: Contradictory and duplicate notes: Electric Transmission Notes duplicated as both numbered and unnumbered items; Item 15 duplicates Item 2; Fire Zone Notes #4 duplicates general Notes #2; inconsistent fire suppression system reference ('NFPAR 13' vs 'NFPA 13D').

details.text: Garbled or corrupted text in Electric Transmission Notes on the General Notes sheet: 'Not empty reasons, aerial equipment, dumpsters...' This passage appears to be a transcription error and is illegible/nonsensical. Replace with correct information.

runComments.comment: Corrupted or garbled text appears in Electric Transmission Notes: 'Not empty reasons, aerial equipment, dumpsters...' which appears to be a transcription error and is illegible/nonsensical.

details.text: Cover sheet title block shows a DCM Waiver approval date of 01/21/2026, but the site plan submittal date is 05/20/2025 — a logical inconsistency where approval post-dates submission by 8 months. Correct one or both dates to establish proper chronological sequence.

runComments.comment: Title block date inconsistency: DCM Waiver approval date (01/21/2026) appears on cover sheet dated 01/21/2026, but site plan submittal date is 05/20/2025. The waiver date is chronologically after the submittal date, suggesting either the waiver date is incorrect or the approval post-dates the submission by approximately 8 months.
